accumulation_bounds_limitation: Annual IMD files label daily dates but do not encode explicit accumulation bounds
date_window: June 1 through October 3 inclusive for each listed year
description: Descriptive daily IMD context across six evaluated monsoon seasons; not climatology or a trend test
domain: 10–22 N, 68–80 E on the 0.25-degree grid; 1301 common land-cell positions with per-day missingness excluded
